briefdescription.para: Runs the QSPI Flash polled example.
Implements a design example using the QSPI driver (XQspiPs) in polled mode with a serial FLASH device.

detaileddescription.para: The example performs some transfers in Auto mode and Manual start mode, to illustrate the modes available. It is recommended to use Manual CS + Auto start for best performance. The hardware which this example runs on. must have a serial FLASH (Numonyx N25Q, Winbond W25Q, Spansion S25FL, ISSI IS25WP) for it to run. The example has been tested with the Numonyx Serial Flash (N25Q128) and IS25WP series flash parts.
